title: Beautiful UI
body: Would love to see this app integrated into Apple Watches with Apple health. The need to have to enter steps etc at the end of the day is a nuisance, when it could just be retrieving that data from the Apple health app
author: todd_10

title: Great app and helpful developer!
body: I have been enjoying the app for some time now, especially since its recent updates. I love how simple and colourful it is, especially with the home screen widgets - there’s no barrier to quickly entering a log for the day. When I ran into a question about using the app, I emailed Sebastian the developer and he was very prompt and helpful in replying.
author: Hannah The Third

title: Low key best habit tracker app on the market
body: This habit tracking app isn’t that popular yet, but it’s the best, in my opinion. It also seems to be new and is getting new features and improvements added all the all the time with updates. Highly recommend
author: w11iy
